name: Spore
author: Erin Carter
description: Tiny bioluminescent spores climb slow helices around invisible vertical axes at three depth layers, rising and swinging in teal–violet light over a near-black water column while each fades in low and out high to hide the wrap.

params.label: Rise speed
params.effect: Vertical climb rate of the spores along their helices; the orbital swing rate scales with it so paths keep their pitch.

params.label: Helix radius
params.effect: Radius of the helical orbits in CSS pixels — wide lazy swings versus tight glittering columns.

params.label: Spore size
params.effect: Glow radius of the nearest-layer points in CSS pixels; the two farther depth layers scale down proportionally.
